title: Probability and Probability Distributions
curriculum_locator: Printed page 5, Stat H-102; four-year program, starting session 2023–2024

units.title: Experiments, Events, Counting and Probability Models
scope: Classical, empirical, subjective and axiomatic probability
Probability axioms, complements, inclusion–exclusion and bounds
worked_questions: Uniform committee selection and alternative sampling designs
Reconstructing a three-event model from overlapping probabilities
Pairwise independence without mutual independence
units.simulation_plan: Finite outcome explorer comparing ordered draws, unordered samples and nonuniform mechanisms; enumerate exact results before random trials.

units.title: Conditional Probability, Independence and Bayesian Updating
scope: Bayes theorem, odds and likelihood ratios
worked_questions: Batch-origin updating after an inspection signal
Sequential sampling without replacement
Common-source dependence and conditional independence
units.simulation_plan: Bayes frequency-tree explorer with prior and signal-rate controls; show denominators and exact expected frequencies.

units.title: Random Variables, Distribution Functions and Transformations
scope: Functions of random variables and change of variables
worked_questions: Discrete transformation with merged outcomes
Piecewise continuous density and quantiles
Nonmonotone transformation with two inverse branches
units.simulation_plan: Density versus probability explorer with interval shading and a mixed-distribution option.

units.title: Joint Distributions, Expectations and Conditional Variation
scope: Expected values of functions, sums and products
Conditional expectation, iterated expectation and total variance
worked_questions: A joint finite table with conditional means
A triangular joint density
Mixture mean and variance with a hidden group
units.simulation_plan: Joint-table explorer with marginal sums and conditional slices; reject negative or zero-total inputs.

units.title: Moments, Generating Functions and Cumulants
worked_questions: Moments and cumulants of a two-point law
Independent sums via generating functions
A distribution with a characteristic function but no finite MGF near zero
units.simulation_plan: No separate simulation planned; exact symbolic derivations and numerical transform checks serve this unit better.

units.title: Bernoulli, Binomial and Hypergeometric Models
scope: Binomial probabilities, moments and generating functions
worked_questions: A binomial tail with independent trials
A finite-population inspection sample
Contrasting equal means under two sampling mechanisms
units.simulation_plan: With- versus without-replacement explorer with exact PMFs and finite-population variance.

units.title: Waiting Counts, Negative Binomial and Poisson Laws
scope: Poisson counts and independent increments assumptions
worked_questions: Waiting until the first success
Waiting until the third success
Poisson count aggregation and thinning
units.simulation_plan: Waiting-count explorer that labels failures versus trials explicitly.

units.title: Uniform, Exponential and Gamma Distributions
scope: Sums of exponential variables and limitations of waiting-time models
worked_questions: A uniform transformation and interval probability
An exponential conditional survival calculation
A gamma waiting-time tail with integer shape
units.simulation_plan: Survival explorer showing exponential memorylessness and contrasting gamma conditional survival.

units.title: Normal and Beta Distributions
scope: Choosing between bounded and unbounded models
worked_questions: Normal interval and tail probabilities
A beta density with polynomial parameters
An independent normal linear combination
units.simulation_plan: Normal and beta shape explorers with labeled axes, exact parameter summaries and keyboard controls.

units.title: Model Synthesis, Approximation and Reproducible Probability
scope: A decision map for the named distributions
Law of large numbers and a carefully scoped central limit introduction
Sensitivity analysis and coherent probability reporting
worked_questions: Exact versus Poisson approximation of a rare-event tail
Monte Carlo precision with an explicit variance calculation
A complete mixture model with conditional prediction
units.simulation_plan: Convergence explorer with fixed seeds, exact target probabilities and labeled sampling error; no claim that a simulation proves a theorem.

editorial_supplements: Counting is integrated with finite probability models. Unit 10 adds model selection, introductory convergence and computation; these are teaching supplements, not additional claims about the named course. Later Mathematical Statistics and Simulation books retain advanced asymptotic proofs and Monte Carlo algorithms.
publication_status: Blocked until all units, measured substantive word minimum, exactly three solved questions per unit, academic review, simulation tests, integration and live verification are complete.
